# PhysxAutoDeformableAttachmentAPI

An authoring container that generates vertex attachments and element collision filters between its two attachables, a deformable body and a second deformable body or an [Xformable](glossary.md#xformable)'s colliders. The runtime finds it by the applied API at load; on an [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) attach the attachment and filter children are generated in memory and their data is computed from these columns.

- **Applies to:** `Xformable`, [`Imageable`](glossary.md#imageable)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## What USD population writes

Published like any applied physics API: every declared attribute at its resolved value, relationships only when authored; a [prim](glossary.md#prim) carrying this API is in physics scope on its own. No column is rewritten or created by the producer.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema value. *Producer writes* is what ovstage population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `physxAutoDeformableAttachment:attachable0` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | No attachment: both attachable relationships must exist with exactly one target each, otherwise attachable parsing fails with a warning and nothing is generated. A target is a deformable body (OmniPhysicsDeformableBodyAPI) or an Xformable whose colliders are used; supported pairs are volume-volume, volume-surface and deformable-Xformable, in either order. |
| `physxAutoDeformableAttachment:attachable1` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | Same as attachable0: without exactly one target on each relationship nothing is generated. |
| `physxAutoDeformableAttachment:collisionFilteringOffset` | float32 | length | `-inf` | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 **diverges** | 0: elements are filtered only where they overlap the other actor. A non-finite value (the schema fallback -inf) selects the heuristic, 10% of the smaller average dimension of the two actors, so write the value you mean. |
| `physxAutoDeformableAttachment:deformableVertexOverlapOffset` | float32 | length | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0: a deformable vertex is attached only where it lies inside the other actor. |
| `physxAutoDeformableAttachment:enableCollisionFiltering` | bool8 | none | true | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | false **diverges** | false: no collision filtering is computed and the generated filter children are published disabled. USD's fallback is true, so write the value. |
| `physxAutoDeformableAttachment:enableDeformableFilteringPairs` | bool8 | none | false | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | false | false: between two deformable bodies every overlapping element of one is filtered against every overlapping element of the other, instead of per overlapping element pair. Not used with an Xformable attachable. |
| `physxAutoDeformableAttachment:enableDeformableVertexAttachments` | bool8 | none | true | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | false **diverges** | false: no vertex attachments are computed and the generated attachment children are published disabled. USD's fallback is true, so write the value. |
| `physxAutoDeformableAttachment:enableRigidSurfaceAttachments` | bool8 | none | false | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | false | false. The flag has no effect in this runtime: rigid surface sampling is compiled out, so the value only enters the attachment input CRC. |
| `physxAutoDeformableAttachment:maskShapes` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | No mask: every vertex and element is a candidate. Sphere, Cube and Capsule targets restrict attachments to points inside them (filtering to points within collisionFilteringOffset of them); other targets are ignored. |
| `physxAutoDeformableAttachment:rigidSurfaceSamplingDistance` | float32 | length | `-inf` | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0. The value has no effect in this runtime (rigid surface sampling is compiled out); it only enters the attachment input CRC, so the schema fallback -inf and an omitted column generate the same attachment. |

## Interactions

- **[`OmniPhysicsDeformableBodyAPI`](OmniPhysicsDeformableBodyAPI.md):** An attachable carrying OmniPhysicsDeformableBodyAPI is re-parsed as a deformable body (and auto-cooked when it enables PhysxAutoDeformableBodyAPI generation) before the attachment data is computed.

## Notes

- The parameters are read when the attachment is set up or refreshed at load; the runtime does not watch them for live changes, and a refresh recomputes the data only when the input CRC over the parameters, the mask shapes and the attachables' cooked mesh data changed.
- With a stage the runtime can author, the input CRC is stored in and read back from physxAutoDeformableAttachment:inputCrc, a runtime bookkeeping attribute no schema declares; on an ovstage attach it is kept in memory. It is not described here.
